expected_behavior: Building retrofit is outside the corpus. Long generic boilerplate must not create a product match or evidence.
source_text_for_pdf:
1. Work: seismic retrofit and façade repair of the municipal records building.
2. Install carbon-fibre reinforcement at nominated beams and columns.
3. Replace expansion joints and repair concrete spalling.
4. Provide scaffolding, debris removal, protection screens and a site safety plan.
5. Submit structural calculations, material certificates and inspection reports.
6. General conditions: sealed tender, tax registration, bank information, non-blacklisting declaration, delivery plan, insurance, warranty, signed forms and purchaser right to clarify or reject bids.
7. No mechanical water equipment is included in the work scope.
